rationale: The round-2 exchange is more explicit and numerically focused, but the core dispute remains unresolved: labour, state, and in part the workforce insist on no closures/no compulsory redundancies, while management, family holding, and investors still keep both on the table. Positions have hardened into a stable but not yet final impasse, so another round is still warranted to test whether a non-closure package can be made economically equivalent.
